name: 會議工作頁、共同確認與主持人發布鎖定
requiresEnv: Existing OA, Drive, Notion, LIFF and task service configuration; no shared production identifiers
definitionOfDone: Existing meeting switches preserved; only new recordings offered
Uploader is immutable host; current source-conversation members can edit
Reusable conversation-local type prompts and A/B/C speaker settings
Streaming original Drive audio; draft production has no publication side effects
Shared review with named colored presence, field conflicts and audit history

Host confirms the latest revision; same URL locks permanently on publication

Latest full production modules/settings/assets/schedules preserved and read back
Real-user new recording acceptance reported separately
